 BRI Super League Schedule November 20–22, 2026: Persib vs Bali United, PSM vs Persija, Check Kick-off Times
 The BRI Super League enters its 10th week with nine matches scheduled from November 20–22, 2026, featuring key clashes between top-tier clubs.
 By: Damar Prasetya 
 | 
 Editor: Nayla Savitri 
 | 
 Contributor: Keisya Anjani 
 November 18, 2026 at 10:30 PM WITA ·
 5 min read
 Photo caption: Illustration of a football stadium hosting 2026/2027 BRI Super League matches. Nine games are scheduled for November 20–22, 2026, including the Persib Bandung vs Bali United and PSM Makassar vs Persija Jakarta duels. Credit: Illustration/Aktualita.co. 
 JAKARTA, Aktualita.co -   The BRI Super League 2026/2027 schedule is once again the focus of national football fans as the competition enters its 10th week. Nine matches are scheduled to take place from Friday to Sunday, November 20–22, 2026, with several important games that have the potential to shift the current standings. 
 Two matches are the main highlights: PSM Makassar against Persija Jakarta and Persib Bandung facing Bali United. Both games involve teams with different objectives, ranging from maintaining the top spot to chasing the upper-table competition.

 Persija currently leads the standings with 21 points from nine matches. Dewa United follows in second place with 20 points, while Bali United and Madura United both have 19 points. 
 Meanwhile, Persib Bandung is in fifth place with 16 points. This situation makes this week's matches even more interesting because the point gap between top-tier clubs remains relatively slim. 
 Based on the official I.League schedule checked on Wednesday (11/18/2026), matches will take place at two main times: 15:30 WIB and 19:00 WIB. 
 Complete BRI Super League Schedule November 20–22, 2026 
 Here is the full schedule for the 10th week of the BRI Super League 2026/2027, including kick-off times and host stadiums. 
 Friday, November 20, 2026 
 15:30 WIB / 16:30 WITA: Garudayaksa FC vs Madura United — Pakansari Stadium. 
 15:30 WIB / 16:30 WITA: PSS Sleman vs Arema FC — Maguwoharjo Stadium. 
 19:00 WIB / 20:00 WITA: Dewa United vs Persita Tangerang — Banten International Stadium. 
 Saturday, November 21, 2026 
 15:30 WIB / 16:30 WITA: Persik Kediri vs PSIM Yogyakarta — Brawijaya Stadium. 
 15:30 WIB / 16:30 WITA: Persebaya Surabaya vs Java United FC — Gelora Bung Tomo Stadium. 
 19:00 WIB / 20:00 WITA: PSM Makassar vs Persija Jakarta — Gelora B.J. Habibie Stadium. 
 19:00 WIB / 20:00 WITA: Bhayangkara Lampung FC vs Persijap Jepara — PKOR Sumpah Pemuda Stadium. 
 Sunday, November 22, 2026 
 15:30 WIB / 16:30 WITA: Isenmulang Kalteng FC vs Borneo FC Samarinda — Tuah Pahoe Stadium. 
 19:00 WIB / 20:00 WITA: Persib Bandung vs Bali United — Gelora Bandung Lautan Api Stadium. 
 All schedules are subject to change if there are adjustments from the competition operator. 
 PSM Makassar vs Persija Jakarta Becomes a Key Match 
 The match between PSM Makassar and Persija Jakarta is expected to be one of the most interesting duels this weekend. 
 Persija arrives as the league leader after collecting 21 points. The team nicknamed the Kemayoran Tigers needs a win to maintain their lead over their closest competitors. 
 Conversely, PSM Makassar sits in 12th place with 10 points. Playing in front of their home crowd is an opportunity for Juku Eja to improve their position in the standings. 
 Persija coach, Shin Tae-yong, previously emphasized that his team must maintain focus when facing every opponent. 
 "For me, every team has good quality. Therefore, we must always be vigilant and cannot afford to lose concentration," said Persija Jakarta coach, Shin Tae-yong. 
 In addition to tactical aspects, the away trip to Parepare is also a concern for Persija. The players' physical condition is considered important because the team is also facing a dense series of matches throughout November. 
 The PSM vs Persija match is scheduled for Saturday (11/21/2026) at 19:00 WIB or 20:00 WITA. 
 Persib Bandung vs Bali United, A Top-Table Duel 
 Another big match brings together Persib Bandung and Bali United on Sunday (11/22/2026). 
 Persib will return to using the Gelora Bandung Lautan Api Stadium as their home ground after previously playing several matches at Si Jalak Harupat Stadium. 
 The return of the Maung Bandung to GBLA is an important momentum because the team must face a fairly tight schedule until December. 
 Persib coach, Igor Tolic, welcomed the updated condition of the GBLA pitch, although he emphasized the importance of player readiness for the upcoming match. 
 Bali United is not an easy opponent. The club from the Island of the Gods is in third place with 19 points and has scored 26 goals in nine matches. 
 That productivity is a challenge for Persib's defense. A victory over Bali United would open up opportunities for the Maung Bandung to close the gap with the top-tier group. 
 Lower-Table Competition Is No Less Interesting 
 In addition to the big club matches, the competition at the bottom of the table is also a concern. 
 PSS Sleman will face Arema FC in a difficult situation. PSS is in 16th place with five points after nine matches. 
 The club nicknamed the Super Elang Jawa has also just made a coaching change. Demerson Bruno Costa has been entrusted to handle the team as interim coach following the end of the partnership with Pieter Huistra. 
 Meanwhile, PSIM Yogyakarta, which is in 17th place, will face Persik Kediri. 
 Persijap Jepara also faces an important match against Bhayangkara Lampung FC. Persijap is still at the bottom of the standings with two points, so they need a positive result to improve their position. 
 With the competition still long, every point is important, especially for teams trying to get out of the relegation zone. 
 BRI Super League Live Broadcast Schedule on TV and Streaming 
 Indonesian football fans can follow the 2026/2027 BRI Super League matches through the Vidio streaming service. 
 A number of selected matches are also broadcast via Indosiar. However, viewers are advised to re-check the television broadcast schedule because not all matches are broadcast live on the same channel. 
 For viewers in central Indonesia, match times need to be adjusted to WITA. A 19:00 WIB kick-off means it takes place at 20:00 WITA. 
 The 10th week of the BRI Super League is expected to present fierce competition, especially because the top-tier clubs are only separated by a few points. 
 The results of the PSM vs Persija match and the Persib vs Bali United match have the potential to influence the competition map heading into the following week. 
 Therefore, national football fans need to pay attention to the match schedule, kick-off time changes, and the latest standings throughout this weekend.
